//: Shared ranking fixture. Asserted by BOTH core/server/search/score_test.go and core/tests/unit/search-score.test.ts while the Go and TypeScript scorers coexist: two independent implementations of one ranking diverge silently otherwise, and the palette and the CLI would order the same query differently. Delete alongside the TS copy once ordering is server-side only.

cases.why: an exact title match outranks everything
a title prefix beats a mid-title word prefix
every term prefixing some word still ranks above a bare substring
terms in the title but out of query order cannot be a prefix, so they land in the all-terms tier
terms matching the title's leading words in order are a prefix, which outranks all-terms
a title-only substring, no term prefixing a word boundary
a subtitle match when the title does not match at all
meta counts as secondary text too
the backend matched invisible content (a mail body, file text)
punctuation folds to a space, so these normalize identically
no usable terms scores the floor rather than erroring
one term missing from the title drops out of the all-terms tier
